info.title: StuHelper Resources API
info.description: Configurable resource taxonomy, reviewed publications, access grants and authorized packages. No provider identities or credentials.

delete.summary: Delete an own never-published draft or rejected resource

400.description: resources_invalid_input for invalid input, including missing category on a new complaint, an unknown category, or a blank reason.

429.description: 请求过于频繁，稍后重试

parameters.description: When true (requires course_id and empty parent_id/after), returns the full course directory tree up to 500 nodes.

Download quarantined file for an authorized current review

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs referenced by own records, at most 100. Any unowned ID rejects the whole batch.

get.description: Returns only catalog names referenced by the caller own uploaded resources and versions. Requests and complaints do not grant access to catalog associations. Unowned IDs reject the whole batch with 404; current content admission is not required.

get.summary: Read actual coverage for a billing plan ID

put.summary: Replace plan coverage with revision control; coverage.manage permission required

schema.description: At most 100 readable course IDs; duplicates coalesce. Omit for only the total.
Lowercase filename extension without the dot.

get.description: Current-visible published resource counts using the same predicates as ListResources, before pagination. Counts describe discoverable metadata, independently of download entitlement. Each requested course must belong to the authorized school. No cross-request cache.
Authenticated owner only. resource_count matches the owned list across current states; published_count is the published subset. No owner parameter is accepted.

get.summary: Find published resources with identical file digest in the same course
get.description: Checks published resources in the target course (including merged course aliases) matching the SHA-256 file digest. Requires both discover and upload permissions in the school.

get.summary: List own purchased and granted resources

schema.description: Lowercase filename extension without the dot.

get.description: Lists non-blocked resources unlocked by the authenticated caller through non-revoked purchases (including ordinary unlisted items) or active non-expired direct grants. Requires current content admission in each returned school.

post.summary: Withdraw an own pending proposal back to draft

verified_instructor.description: Optional opt-in for verified course instructors; server-verified against current Authority and Catalog facts.
Server-verified snapshot indicating the version was submitted by a verified instructor of the course.

access_reason.description: allowed, requirements_missing, purchase_unavailable, resource_unavailable, permission_denied or service_unavailable. Owned metadata remains readable if file eligibility is unavailable. Use missing_conditions and unavailable_conditions rather than assuming that every failure requires a purchase.

operation_state.description: Scoped administrator view only: current background review or publication job state for the active proposal.

operation_error_code.description: Scoped administrator view only: sanitized error code of the active proposal background job.

total.description: Total matching current-visible records before cursor pagination.

Request.description: New complaints require a category, nonblank contact details and one to four evidence entries. Withdrawals and appeals omit category. All requests require a nonblank reason of at most 2000 Unicode characters. For other, explain the violation in reason. A legacy complaint can replay its already accepted request using its original body and idempotency key.

resource_title.description: Title snapshot at request submission. Present for an owner request, or when a complaint passed current content admission at submission. Omitted for other complaints and historical requests without an admission snapshot.

subject_key.description: Stable issuer/subject key, visible only to grant administrators.

purchase_available.description: Resources supports purchase delivery. Backend must also check billing availability and merge prices.

ViolationCategory.description: Fixed Moderation violation category used for resource complaints. illegal_content (违法违规), pornography (色情低俗), gambling_drugs (赌博毒品违禁品), fraud (诈骗钓鱼), violence_threat (暴力威胁), minors_harm (危害未成年人), personal_attack (辱骂攻击), harassment_discrimination (骚扰歧视), defamation_rumor (诽谤谣言), privacy_leak (泄露隐私), impersonation (冒充他人), copyright (侵犯著作权), other_ip (侵犯其他权益), academic_integrity (学术不端), leaked_exam (泄露试题), fake_review (不实评价), wrong_teacher (教师或课程对应错误), wrong_info (信息错误), spam (广告垃圾), malware (恶意文件或链接), duplicate (重复内容), low_quality (内容质量低), author_update (作者要求更新), other (其他).
